_notes.shape: Per-venture query strategy. The activity-shipped renderer in packages/crane-mcp/src/cli/docs-refresh-io.ts reads this to construct gh CLI calls.
_notes.topology: vc lives in the crane-console monorepo; dfg lives in its own dfg-console repo.
_notes.adding_a_venture: Add an entry under .ventures.<code> with primaryRepo and shippedSearch. Then run 'docs-refresh --init-markers <code>' to seed the managed block on docs/ventures/<code>/product-overview.md.
_notes.retired: The roadmap page type, its issue-label queries and the per-venture labels block were retired on 2026-10-23 together with the per-venture roadmap pages.
